column3: Close to the Hebrew; the Hebrew names a constellation (Mazzaroth), rendered “a constellation,” and “her young ones” is rendered “her satellites.”
“The inner parts” is rendered “the innermost being,” and a rare Hebrew word as “the mind”; the meaning of that word is uncertain.
“Who will make lie down the waterskins” is rendered “tip the water jars.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the life of young lions” is rendered “the appetite of the young lions.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in the thicket” is rendered “in their lair.”
